g.text: PROJECT 100 / DESCRIPTIVE VECTOR RECORD / 5 OCTOBER 2026
V10 SHUTDOWN
DEPLOYMENT
Night anchor across all three states
BASE
800 mL Traditional Medicinals Hibiscus Tisane, comfortable temperature
INGREDIENTS
SD Pharmaceuticals Creatine HCl 750 mg; North Coast Naturals Fermented L-Glutamine 5
g; AOR Pure Glycine Powder 3-5 g; optional half-scoop Medi-C Plus (2.5 g); rare
Niyama Hey Relax full scoop
PROTOCOL
Night anchor (18:30 reference); morning training, rest and evening-training
branches. Tisane at a comfortable temperature.
MECHANISM
Nocturnal recovery: second creatine pulse, 5 g glutamine, 3-5 g glycine. Optional
Medi-C adds 1,000 mg vitamin C and 105 mg magnesium; Hey Relax adds 200 mg magnesium
and 1,000 mg inositol. The old 60-65 degree Celsius heating rule is retired.
STACK INTERACTION
Magnesium 341-646 mg + high- dose vitamin C + continuous bile trickle — Loose stools
are predictable system output; log and moderate fat bolus before blaming single
foods.
MARGIN
Supplemental magnesium: training baseline 341 mg; up to 646 mg with options, versus
350 mg/day supplemental UL. Rest totals are lower and not fully quantified.
MONITOR
Stool, pain, weakness, sleep and performance noted; options marked as taken or
skipped.
STOP RULE
Recurrent watery stools with weight loss, oily stools or significant abdominal pain:
stop and seek assessment.
Personal system record; not a safety guarantee or prescription.
